limits: Diagnostic runs perturb timing; retained mode forces GC and traverses terms, changing heap behavior. Use natural mode for sampled peaks.
Term heap sizes preserve sharing within each measured term; component sizes overlap and must not be summed. Off-heap binary bodies are excluded from term heap sizes.
GC measures worker liveness at instrumented boundaries, not total bytes allocated over time. Hooks can affect compiler liveness. VM memory is not RSS.
natural_gc additionally traces worker GC with monotonic VM timestamps and brackets worker reads with VM snapshots; tracing perturbs execution. Heap block sizes in GC events are words.
Natural samples every 500 ms may miss short peaks; 8 GB VM / 900 second guards are sampled, not hard OS quotas.
One large observation per version, no warmup; CPU-speed improvement not established
Opportunity generation also ran slower in the new large run although that phase is unchanged; wall-time observations are not a controlled CPU attribution
VM memory sampled each second, not RSS or hard OS quota; short peaks can be missed
100-asset parity is compact result projection plus exact path work count; whole report term identity is checked at six assets
Retained-term sizing is diagnostic and forces GC; logical cache release need not immediately reclaim every shared object or heap capacity
Synthetic clustered 250-second mission, not operational acceptance or independent physical validation
